name: 87121 · Albuquerque, NM
findings: ZIP 87121 (Albuquerque) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87121 (Albuquerque) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 87121 (Albuquerque) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
